dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed and semi-closed loops ('O' and 'C' shapes) are visible. The most prominent structures show high-frequency spatial variation along their light-intensity perimeters, with sharp contrast boundaries against the dark base pixels. Gradients transition abruptly from the dark exterior to the high-intensity ring, with some central interior regions returning to a lower intensity state.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of compact, high-intensity pixel clusters is observed. These are interspersed among the macro-annuli, particularly in the mid-dorsal region. Each cluster consists of a small, contiguous group of high-value pixels with minimal internal intensity variance.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the upper right quadrant define a scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a roughly linear chain descending towards the posterior-lateral edge.
